visualCharacteristics.purpose: scroller of portrait short-video thumbnails with a play icon and view count
notes: Portrait short-video thumbnails with play icon and view count in a scroller.

Centered heading with bullet dots; horizontal carousel of portrait short-video thumbnails with view counts and play icons (third-party SaleAssist widget injected client-side; not present in cleaned.html).

contentPattern.structure: one row per video; cell 1: thumbnail image; cell 2: video link and optional view count / caption
cells: Text: optional heading/title, description, CTA link
reasons: Repeating look-alike video tiles in a scroller: Cards (thumbnail image + video link). Content is injected by a third-party widget at runtime, so author the representative thumbnails captured from the live page (prod-saleassist.gumlet.io thumbnails).

reuseGuidance: Reuse cards-video-reel wherever the same pattern appears (s15 (Explore Our Featured Products (video reels)): Short video reel thumbnails (about 11) with view counts). Section styles seen: centered.
